title: Synthetic AI Transparency and User Recourse Policy

sections.title: AI interaction notice
sections.text: External users must receive clear notice when they interact with AI or receive materially AI-generated content. The notice must describe the feature purpose, important limitations, and how to reach human support.

sections.title: Consequential decision explanation and appeal
sections.text: A person affected by an AI-supported consequential decision must receive understandable reasons, information about the role of AI, access to human review, and a practical method to correct data or appeal the outcome.

sections.title: Personalization and retention disclosure
sections.text: Personalized AI experiences must explain which account or activity data affects recommendations, how long that data is retained, and how a user can disable personalization or delete stored preference data.
